about: Jaysynth Orgochem Ltd, formerly JD Orgochem Ltd, is a specialty-colourants and digital-printing-solutions company. It manufactures and trades dyestuffs, digital inks, textile auxiliaries, pigments and pigment dispersions at Taloja and Patalganga, Maharashtra, and trades inkjet printers for digital printing.
